span.p:
Responsibilities:
• Single contact point for customer requests
• Analyze incoming requests
• Dispatch tasks to specialized agents
• Synthesize agent answers
• Create the final customer answer
• Limits per run: max 10 subagent calls, max 20 tool calls (soft limit)

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Responsibilities:
• Track company inventory
• Answer inventory-related questions
• Check whether goods requests can be fulfilled
• Assess reorder needs
• Place explicitly requested stock reorders
• max 10 steps, max 20 tool calls per run
